name: Get vars & save
func:
//convert to numbers
msg.payload = msg.payload.split(' ').map(Number);
//get number to display
var v1_inp = { payload: msg.payload[0] },
    v1_out = { payload: msg.payload[1] },
    v2_inp = { payload: msg.payload[2] },
    v2_out = { payload: msg.payload[3] },
    v1_gap_inp = { payload: msg.payload[4] },
    v1_gap_out = { payload: msg.payload[5] },
    v2_gap_inp = { payload: msg.payload[6] },
    v2_gap_out = { payload: msg.payload[7] },
    v3_gap_inp = { payload: msg.payload[8] },
    v3_gap_out = { payload: msg.payload[9] },
    v4_gap_inp = { payload: msg.payload[10] },
    v4_gap_out = { payload: msg.payload[11] },
    v5_gap_inp = { payload: msg.payload[12] },
    v5_gap_out = { payload: msg.payload[13] },
    use_calib  = { payload: msg.payload[14] };

//save as flow context
global.set(["v1_inp", "v1_out",
          "v2_inp", "v2_out",
          "v1_gap_inp", "v1_gap_out",
          "v2_gap_inp", "v2_gap_out",
          "v3_gap_inp", "v3_gap_out",
          "v4_gap_inp", "v4_gap_out",
          "v5_gap_inp", "v5_gap_out", 
          "use_calib"],
          
    [v1_inp, v1_out,
     v2_inp, v2_out,
        
    v1_gap_inp, v1_gap_out,
    v2_gap_inp, v2_gap_out,
    v3_gap_inp, v3_gap_out,
    v4_gap_inp, v4_gap_out,
    v5_gap_inp, v5_gap_out,
    use_calib
        ]);


   
return [v1_inp, v1_out,
        v2_inp, v2_out,
        v1_gap_inp, v1_gap_out,
        v2_gap_inp, v2_gap_out,
        v3_gap_inp, v3_gap_out,
        v4_gap_inp, v4_gap_out,
        v5_gap_inp, v5_gap_out,
        use_calib];
